svg.aria-label: Patch press for the NSA Net outage of 17 November 2026. A heavy press stamps an emergency PATCH plate onto the NSA Net server cell; the press has knocked the cell offline — its status lamp is dead, the health dial's needle sits in the orange zone, and the CODE GRAY lamp is lit. The big rollback lever is thrown over to the ROLL BACK detent, the only way back. A queue drum holds the delayed jobs, parked not lost, and five small blocks are the five major outages in six days. Numbers from the incident: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2 each; the bug lived in PHP code for about 14 years, since PHP 5.4; emergency patches shipped October 21, 2026 (PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35); NSA Net went down November 17, 2026, the fifth major outage in six days after Microsoft 365 on November 12, the FAA on November 13, Chase on November 16 and Apple on November 17.
